newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: EU's Van Mierlo to visit Egypt on February 18.
newsitem.headline: EU's Van Mierlo to visit Egypt on February 18.

text.p: Foreign Minister Hans van Mierlo of the Netherlands, which holds the European Union presidency, will visit Egypt on February 18 for talks with President Hosni Mubarak, a government spokesman said on Tuesday.
He said Van Mierlo would also visit Qatar a day earlier to take part in a meeting of Gulf states.
The Dutch have put relations with the Middle East high on their EU presidency agenda.

Van Mierlo, speaking during a visit to The Hague by Palestinian President Yasser Arafat on Monday, stressed Europe was keen to play a complementary role alongside the United States in the peace process.
The Dutch will also host a visit from Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu on February 12.
